glosses: gesture (communicative motion of the limbs or body)
gesture (act or a remark that serves as a formality or as a sign of attitude)

examples.en: He made a gesture with his hand.
Her gestures convey no meaning to me.

examples.text: Я ценю этот жест, но этого недостаточно.
examples.en: I appreciate the gesture, but it's not enough.
Sometimes gestures are more expressive than speech.
He made a gesture of impatience.
